covers: JSE morning session and SA data to 11:20 SAST, Wednesday 11 November 2026
headline: SA unemployment edges up to 33.7% in Q3; JSE All Share a little firmer at 114,846, rand R16.55/$
summary: Stats SA's Quarterly Labour Force Survey, released on Tuesday 10 November, showed the official unemployment rate rising to 33.7% in the third quarter from 33.6%, even as employment grew by 101,000 to 16.8 million (SAnews, 10 Nov). The JSE All Share was at 114,846.43 mid-morning on Wednesday, slightly above Tuesday's 114,693.44 close, with the rand at R16.55/$ (LRC Market Dashboard, 11 Nov 10:27 SAST). US stock futures were edging higher after Tuesday's inflation-led fall, while gold held near $4,040 and the US 10-year yield near 5% remains the main pressure on gold, the rand and emerging-market shares.

items.title: US shares close lower and the 10-year yield ends at 4.98% after the inflation surprise
items.summary: The S&P 500 closed at 7,520.93 and the Nasdaq at 25,065.88 on Tuesday, both lower on the day according to a MarketWatch headline. The US 10-year Treasury yield closed at 4.98%. October consumer prices rose 0.4% (0.3% expected) and core prices 0.3% (0.2% expected), and CNBC headlines say this and comments from Fed Governor Waller have raised expectations of a Fed rate hike.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 10 Nov 2026 close; LRC Macro Desk (BLS), 10 Nov 2026; CNBC and MarketWatch headlines, 10 Nov 2026

items.title: Futures edge higher after the Nvidia-led fall
items.summary: CNBC's live page early on Wednesday was headlined 'Stock futures rise slightly as market tries to recover from Nvidia-led decline'. We could not open the page to confirm the size of the moves, so no figures are given.

items.title: CoreWeave beats on revenue and raises guidance
items.summary: CNBC reports the AI cloud company beat revenue forecasts and lifted guidance after Tuesday's close, easing concerns about an AI spending slowdown; MarketWatch says the shares rose after hours. Detailed figures are left out until the report can be checked.

items.title: Alibaba plans to list its T-Head chip unit
items.summary: Alibaba announced plans to list T-Head, which CNBC describes as a rival to Nvidia in chips.

items.title: Unemployment rate rises to 33.7% in the third quarter
items.summary: Stats SA's QLFS showed the official unemployment rate up 0.1 percentage point to 33.7% in Q3 2026 from 33.6% in Q2. Employment rose by 101,000 to 16.8 million and formal-sector jobs by 268,000, but the number of unemployed also rose, by 97,000 to 8.6 million, as more people entered the labour force. The expanded (LU3) measure rose to 44.0%; youth unemployment eased to 47.3%. Released Tuesday 10 November (SAnews).

items.title: JSE All Share at 114,846 mid-morning; Top 40 at 106,950
items.summary: At 10:27 SAST on Wednesday the JSE All Share stood at 114,846.43 and the Top 40 at 106,950.25, a little above Tuesday's closes of 114,693.44 and 106,738.05 (LRC Market Dashboard from Yahoo Finance data, 11 Nov 2026).

items.title: New fuel prices take effect today
items.summary: Adjusted petrol and diesel prices apply from Wednesday 11 November. IOL reports that part of the relief from lower oil prices is taken up by the new 'Slate levy'; we could not open the article to confirm the cents-per-litre changes, so they are left out.

items.title: Nersa admits electricity tariffs in three metros are unlawful
items.summary: Moneyweb reports the energy regulator has conceded that tariffs in three metros were unlawful. Details to follow once the article can be checked.

items.title: Gold closed at $4,055.70, platinum $1,562.50
items.summary: Gold fell on Tuesday as yields and the dollar rose after the inflation data. An Investing.com headline early on Wednesday says gold is steadying near $4,035 as bets on a December Fed hike firm.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 10 Nov 2026 close; Investing.com headline, 11 Nov 2026

items.title: Brent closed at $92.47; copper about $13,916/t
items.summary: Brent dipped briefly below $90 on Tuesday for the first time since August on Iran peace hopes, then rose from that two-month low overnight as attacks on ships near Hormuz offset truce hopes (Investing.com headlines). Brent is down 5.9% on the week.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 10 Nov 2026 close; Investing.com headlines, 10-11 Nov 2026

items.title: Nvidia: second day of selling over the CEO controversy
items.summary: CNBC headlines report Nvidia sold off for a second day on Tuesday over the fallout from CEO Jensen Huang's alleged affair with a suspected spy, and MarketWatch reports Congress may make it harder for Nvidia to sell to China. Shares were at $168.29 (-5.8%) at 18:39 SAST on Tuesday, well below our $262.56 fair value. Results on 17 November are the next test. Our BUY rating is unchanged.
items.source: CNBC and MarketWatch headlines, 10-11 Nov 2026; LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 10 Nov 2026 18:39 SAST; LRC Watchlist

items.title: AMD gives back gains
items.summary: MarketWatch reports AMD's shares faded on Tuesday as investors weighed whether Nvidia's troubles will bring lasting gains for AMD. Our SELL rating is unchanged.
